title: Here’s Where to Watch FC Barcelona vs. Real Madrid Match Live Online
summary: Livestream the 265th edition of EL CLÁSICO online on Sunday (Oct. 25) — for first time on American broadcast TV.
contentText:

One of the biggest and oldest rivalries in sports is FC Barcelona and Real Madrid. The two soccer teams (and fanbases) have been battling each other in various leagues and tournaments since 1902 with an equal share for both.

Watch on DirecTV

Over the last 124 years, Barcelona and Real Madrid played 264 times with an even record of 106 wins each and 52 draws. With the 265th edition of “EL CLÁSICO,” whichever teams win the match on Sunday (Oct. 25) gets the slight edge over their rivals.

How to Watch 2026 EL CLÁSICO Live Online, at a Glance:

- Date: Oct. 25

- Network: ABC in English, ESPN Deportes in Spanish

- Matchup: FC Barcelona vs. Real Madrid

- Online Streaming: DirecTV , Fubo , Hulu + Live TV , Sling TV , ESPN Unlimited

When Does Barcelona vs. Real Madrid Start ?

For LaLiga, EL CLÁSICO takes place on Sunday (Oct. 25) with Barcelona (9-0-0; 27 points) taking on Real Madrid (7-0; 21 points) at Spotify Camp Nou in Barcelona, Spain. Kickoff is at 4 p.m. ET/1 p.m. PT.

What TV Network Features Barcelona vs. Real Madrid?

The Barcelona-Real Madrid match broadcasts across two networks, ABC in English and ESPN Deportes in Spanish. Meanwhile, it’s available to livestream in both languages on ESPN Unlimited .

Which Celebrities Are Making Appearances Barcelona vs. Real Madrid?

LaLiga is known for celebrity sightings, so it’s likely there may be a number of famous actors, actresses and recording artists in attendance at the match. Artists who have been known to appear at matches in the past include Barcelona fans Olivia Rodrigo , Shakira, Pau Gasol, Andrea Duro, Nicky Jam and others; Real Madrid fans include Enrique Iglesias, Penélope Cruz, Rafael Nadal and others.

Where to Watch Barcelona vs. Real Madrid Online for Free

For cord-cutters, there are a few ways to watch the Barcelona-Real Madrid match if you don’t have cable, especially if you want to watch for free. DirecTV has a five-day free trial , while other streaming services, such as Fubo and Hulu + Live TV , offer free trials, so you can watch the match for free.
